title: The six operations, the dualizing complex, the duals
statement:
Fix distinct primes $p,\ell$, integers $a,n\geq1$, put $q=p^a$, let $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, and fix an algebraic closure $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of $k_0$. Fix a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside a chosen algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$. Put $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ and let $\Lambda\in\{A_{E,n},\mathcal O_E,E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell\}$. Let $d\geq0$ be an integer, let $X_0/k_0$ be smooth of relative dimension $d$, separated of finite type and geometrically connected, and put $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$, $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $a_X:X\to s$ its structure morphism. These are the geometric and coefficient data of [sk-def-set]; properness of $X_0$ is not assumed.

For a finite-type $k$-scheme $T$, use the bounded constructible finite-Tor category $\Dctf(T,\Lambda)$ on its small pro-etale site defined in [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. For separated finite-type $k$-morphisms $f:T\to U$ between such schemes, use the six operations
$$Lf^*,\quad Rf_*,\quad Rf_!,\quad Rf^!,\quad\otimes^L_\Lambda,\quad R\mathcal H om_\Lambda$$
of [sk-def-sf-operations]. Here $Rf_!$ is defined by a compactification and $Rf^!$ is its constructible right adjoint on $\Dctf$, which exists for every such $f$; no ambient adjoint on the full pro-etale derived category is required. For $T=X$ or $T=s$, write $\Lambda_T$ for the coefficient unit at the chosen stage: the constant finite-level unit, the completed integral unit for $\Lambda=\mathcal O_E$, or the corresponding rational/common-stage unit, as specified in [def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology].

Define the dualizing complex and, for $K\in\Dctf(X,\Lambda)$, its Verdier and coefficient duals by
$$
\omega_{X,\Lambda}=Ra_X^!\Lambda_s,\qquad
\mathbb D_XK=R\mathcal H om_\Lambda(K,\omega_{X,\Lambda}),\qquad
K^\vee=R\mathcal H om_\Lambda(K,\Lambda_X).
$$
With $\operatorname{Fib}_s$ the coefficient-point functor of [def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology], define
$$
\operatorname{R\Gamma}_c(X,K)=\operatorname{Fib}_s(Ra_{X!}K),\qquad
\operatorname{R\Gamma}(X,K)=\operatorname{Fib}_s(Ra_{X*}K),
$$
and, for every $i\in\mathbf Z$,
$$
H_c^i(X,K)=H^i\bigl(\operatorname{R\Gamma}_c(X,K)\bigr),\qquad
H^i(X,K)=H^i\bigl(\operatorname{R\Gamma}(X,K)\bigr).
$$

split_report.summary: Definition split only: retained the current main-20261015 formulas and unconditional constructible exceptional adjoint; made the existing finite-Tor category, six-operation package and ordinary/compact cohomology definitions explicit statement dependencies. Identified the completed coefficient unit and coefficient-point functor without assuming an ambient adjoint or properness. No new node or proof step is needed. The slopmaster2 definitions named in the blueprint cover ambient categorical formulas only, not every coefficient-stage clause, so no attachment is claimed. Expanded the inherited fixed-setting shorthand into all of its geometric and coefficient hypotheses after preflight B2 rejected the opening phrase; also introduced f, K, i and the coefficient unit explicitly. This changes no mathematical hypothesis or construction. Independent second reading removed the added separatedness of the source and target schemes in the explanatory operation package: the source requires the morphism to be separated, with finite-type k-schemes as in sk-def-sf-operations. Restricted the coefficient-unit notation to X and s, precisely the separated schemes used by the defining formulas and covered by def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology.
